name: markwire
description: Draw and edit ASCII wireframes inside Codex with a local editor.

interface.longDescription: MarkWire opens an interactive ASCII wireframe editor for boxes, dividers, labels, UI components, and layout sketches. Draw on the character grid or ask the model to render a layout from shapes, then copy the result as Markdown. It is a drawing surface with one output, Markdown, and runs entirely from the bundled local server.
defaultPrompt: Sketch a login page as an ASCII wireframe
Open MarkWire so I can draw a layout
